name: Google Workspace
description: Syncs Frogg into Google Sheets, Docs and Slides: an agent run ledger, two-way project to-dos, a report Doc per finished agent, Doc comments sent to the agent with replies posted back, plans exported for review, and release decks.
author: Frogg

commands.title: Google: connect account
commands.description: Sign in with a device code shown in the Google panel

commands.title: Google: sync now
commands.description: Push the ledger and to-dos, and read Sheet edits and Doc comments

commands.title: Google: create release deck
commands.description: A Slides deck from recently finished agents

settings.title: OAuth client ID
settings.description: Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client of type "TVs and Limited Input devices".

settings.title: OAuth client secret
settings.description: Shown next to the client ID. Device clients still need it for the token exchange.

settings.title: Google accounts allowed to drive agents
settings.description: Comma-separated. Only comments and Sheet edits from these accounts reach agents and to-dos. Empty means only the connected account.

settings.title: Agent run ledger (Sheets)
settings.description: One row per agent, updated as it runs.

settings.title: Report Doc when an agent finishes
Sync project to-dos with Sheets
settings.description: Two-way. Edits in the Sheet need remote control turned on for this plugin.

settings.title: Send Doc comments to the agent
settings.description: Comments on a report or plan Doc that start with @frogg go to that agent; its answer is posted as a reply. Needs remote control.

settings.title: Drive folder
settings.description: Everything the plugin creates goes in this folder (and per-project subfolders).
